question: Should schemaVersion 1 reinterpret every non-empty `CLAW.md` body as executable agent prompt material, even for existing packages that use that body as documentation alongside an explicit `SOUL.md` sidecar?
rationale: This is a cross-repository portable-package contract choice with upgrade consequences; a mechanical code repair cannot determine whether backward compatibility, a manifest version transition, or an intentional breaking change is the desired product policy.

options.title: Version the prompt-body contract
options.body: Keep schemaVersion 1 body semantics intact and introduce prompt materialization through a maintainer-approved distinguishable or newer manifest contract, with explicit migration and compatibility coverage.

options.title: Adopt the schema-v1 breaking meaning
options.body: Intentionally make all non-empty schema-v1 bodies prompt material, document the incompatible package shapes, and provide an explicit migration path before landing.

options.title: Pause for RFC alignment
options.body: Hold this implementation until the linked portable-contract discussion establishes the canonical representation and upgrade story across OpenClaw and ClawHub.

recommendation.title: Version the prompt-body contract
recommendation.body: Keep schemaVersion 1 body semantics intact and introduce prompt materialization through a maintainer-approved distinguishable or newer manifest contract, with explicit migration and compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidenced author of the linked portable-contract proposal and can clarify the intended compatibility semantics for maintainer decision.
